jev_migration.reason: Reference thread changed output validator to permit approved Clay/Shale grading family. All saved output labels already equal exact source captions or Unknown; no inference result changed.

inference_policy.chunk_source: Frozen v4 row boundaries and 48-row chunks; run twice with identical-pixel checks
inference_policy.legend: Frozen native machine cache when present; otherwise shared harness machine legend
inference_policy.labels: Individual exact printed captions; genuine compounds retained; no new alias or twin group
inference_policy.queries: 4 per request; 4 concurrent requests; top4 hand + top2 Lab; exact pixel dedup only
inference_policy.output: Best single guess even if weak; bad_crop/failed API becomes Unknown; all weak guesses retain review flags
inference_policy.metric: Unchanged harness scorer, min_layer_px=0; score=row_acc*boundary_f1; zero on case exception; report pixel-only diagnostic when depth fails
inference_policy.timing: Shared preprocessing and strategy runtime separately; cache and cold state explicit; shared machine, not a speed guarantee
inference_policy.external: Declared DEV items only. External test, verify and vault are not read.
inference_policy.grading_supplement: Score both strict_harness and clay_shale_equivalent_v1 from the same saved rows. Approved reference-thread grading rule; contacts, clusters, depths and inference labels unchanged.
